parsed.scene_description: An indoor public space with polished floors and blue-lit glass walls. On the left, a person sits at a desk against a wooden wall with arched recesses. In the center background, two people sit at small white tables near a potted plant and an A-frame sign. To the right, curved shelving units display books and magazines under lighting strips.
